subject.title: [Feature]: Add screenshot capture button to Control UI chat input (like Doubao)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a Control UI screenshot-capture composer button, and what consent, privacy, browser/native support, cancellation, and logging behavior must it enforce?
rationale: The code path is clear, but screen capture changes the privacy boundary and user-facing product model beyond a routine attachment UI fix.

options.title: Hold for capture design
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the static screenshot capture UX, security boundary, and supported browser/native fallback behavior before implementation.

options.title: Approve browser-only static capture
options.body: Allow a focused PR using browser screen-capture APIs only, wired into the existing attachment path with tests and explicit cancel/redaction behavior.

options.title: Decline core capture button
options.body: Keep existing file, paste, and drop attachments as the supported workflow and close this request as out of scope for core UI.

recommendation.title: Hold for capture design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers define the static screenshot capture UX, security boundary, and supported browser/native fallback behavior before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Most recent history owns the current split composer/send surface where the decision would land.
